topic: The 2-adic Metric: Redefining Distance in Infinite Sums

sections.title: Review: The Standard Infinite Sum
lecture_lines: Standard sums grow, racing toward infinity.
animations: Show summation series '1+2+4+8...' below, color #FFFF00, accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pile.svg].
Highlight terms of the series sequentially, color #00FF00.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Changing the 'Lens' of Distance
lecture_lines: Numbers are small if divisible by two.
Higher powers of two mean closer proximity.
We use a tree to visualize this.
animations: Show 2-adic disk split into halves using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg] to focus on the division, color #00FFFF.
Highlight smaller segments for powers of 2, color #FF4500.
Illustrate tree structure branching out, color #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Counter-Intuitive Convergence
lecture_lines: Each step brings us nearer to negative one.
Distance shrinks, settling onto the value.
It does not fly away to infinity.
animations: Animate positive terms jumping toward zero, color #FFD700.
Show total value settling at -1, color #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary & Philosophical Implication
lecture_lines: Distance is defined by our chosen metric.
The world changes with the lens used.
animations: Compare Euclidean and 2-adic lines using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg], color #FFFFFF.
Animate convergence patterns on each, color #00FA9A.
Final text: 'Perspective defines reality' alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/world.svg], color #87CEEB.
